gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with SHA TAU KOK ROAD SHEK CHUNG AU and running in a south south-easterly direction for about 78 metres where it terminates at its junction with SHUN HING STREET as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/N/R4.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與沙頭角公路石涌凹段交界處起，向東南偏南伸展約七十八米，至與順興街交界處終止。在LD/N/R4號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with SHUN LUNG STREET and running in an east north-easterly direction for about 38 metres where it terminates at its junction with CHE PING STREET as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/N/R4.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與順隆街交界處起，向東北偏東伸展約三十八米，至與車坪街交界處終止。在LD/N/R4號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with SHUN HING STREET and running in an east north-easterly direction for about 80 metres and then bends to run northerly for about 12 metres where it terminates at its junction with SHA TAU KOK ROAD SHEK CHUNG AU as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Drawing No. LD/N/R4.
